findings.description: Direct inspection of all five current views and six pose renders confirms V29 bilateral thigh-surface placement materially moves the front overskirt across the upper thighs in sit and crouch, addressing the V28 side-placement failure. It still does not form continuous controlled lap coverage: shorts remain exposed below/through the front opening, with separate pointed panels and raw angular edges around the seated thighs. This is a placement improvement, not accepted pose coverage.

Direct front, back, left, right, three-quarter, neutral, arms-up, arm-cross, sit, crouch, and prone inspection still shows coarse triangular surface faceting, uneven hem lines, and layered or protruding panel corners. The current geometry transfer does not smooth the skirt silhouette or produce clean sewn transitions.
The current back render still does not present a distinct, readable rear adjustment tab or buckle.
Authored UV mapping remains missing. The automatic prototype unwrap is not authored UV evidence, and the inspected images are not a UV layout.

sourceEvidence.currentPrototypeMotif: V29 adds bounded nearest-surface transfer for four front overskirt pieces using the posed body triangles filtered by UpperLeg_L/UpperLeg_R deform weights. Direct inspection confirms the anterior panels now cross the upper thighs in sit and crouch, a measurable geometry-placement improvement over V28. Remaining shorts exposure at the front opening, coarse faceting, uneven/stacked hems, illegible rear adjustment tab, and missing authored UV keep the prototype rejected. The trial establishes no fit, Shape Key, motion, Unity/VRChat runtime, or release acceptance.

nextAction: Keep the V29 geometry-placement method as a useful prototype improvement, but reject the current candidate. Next revise the sewn front panel pattern/coverage so the lap closes across raised thighs without exposing shorts, then smooth/refine skirt topology and boundary transitions, add a legible rear tab/buckle, and author real panel UVs. Rebuild and inspect all five views and six poses directly. Fit, Shape Keys, Unity/VRChat execution, packaging and release remain unverified.
